function listPosts({url,$}) {const posts=[]; $('item,entry').each((_,e)=>{const x=$(e);posts.push({url:x.find('link[rel="alternate"]').attr('href')||x.find('link').attr('href')||x.find('link').text(),title:x.find('title').first().text().trim(),publishedAt:x.find('pubDate,published,updated').first().text().trim()});});return {posts,next:null};}
function parsePost({url,$}){const title=$("article h1").first().text().trim();const body=$("#__blog-post-container").first().clone();body.find('script,style,nav,footer').remove();return {title,bodyHtml:body.html()||'',author:$('meta[name="author"]').attr('content')||$('.p-author').first().text().trim()||null,publishedAt:$('meta[property="article:published_time"]').attr('content')||$('time[datetime]').first().attr('datetime')||null,tags:$('a[rel="tag"]').map((_,e)=>$(e).text().trim()).get()};}
scraper.notes: 首頁公開 Thread atom 訂閱連結；實讀 Atom 與資安是無感的政績，Docusaurus 正文 __blog-post-container。
